Class ServerHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client.ServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ServerHandler extends Object implements Runnable
============================================================================ ServerHandler — Client-side asynchronous listening thread (TCP Socket) ============================================================================ ROLE: Independent thread continuously listening for incoming messages from the server on the TCP Socket connection. WHAT IT DOES: 1. Reads objects from the socket's input stream 2. If it is a PingRequest: automatically answers with a PongResponse (client does nothing, it's automatic) 3. If it is an Update: updates the ClientModel accordingly 4. If the socket closes: stops the thread PING MANAGEMENT (transparent to the client): When the server sends a PingRequest, the client immediately responds with a PongResponse containing the same timestamp. This allows the server to calculate the round-trip time and detect disconnections. ============================================================================
